LibRaw 0.22.3, unmodified official source; CDDL-1.0 selected.
Source: https://www.libraw.org/data/LibRaw-0.22.3.tar.gz
Upstream annotated tag 0.22.3 resolves to commit:
cf02d66eb5c19d4e46df7aee0582e47a4918509a
SHA-256: 789f3c33466210a1a0907f747a97c715d21bbf4af712f257fcbbd90111b227e4
Complete source distribution retained in this application's source repository:
https://github.com/reitojike/cinematic-camera/blob/main/third_party/libraw/LibRaw-0.22.3.tar.gz
Use the APK's source commit/tag in place of main to retrieve that version.
The archive includes both upstream licenses and original file notices.
No LibRaw source files are patched. CDDL-1.0 is selected for this distribution.
Build recipe: app/src/main/cpp/CMakeLists.txt in the same repository.
LibRaw is linked STATIC into libcinematic_dng.so (JNI SHARED), not a shared libraw.so.
NDK r29's C++ runtime is also linked statically (-static-libstdc++).
LibRaw COPYRIGHT, CDDL, DCB BSD, Adobe MIT and the installed NDK r29 toolchain
NOTICE accompany this file. NDK NOTICE covers more than just the linked runtime.
Built without external DNG SDK, JPEG, LCMS, RawSpeed, X3FTOOLS or demosaic packs.
Runtime DT_NEEDED: Android-provided libz.so, libm.so, libdl.so and libc.so.
Those system libraries are not packaged in this APK.
Rebuild: JDK 25, Android SDK 37.0/build-tools 36.0.0, NDK 29.0.14206865,
CMake 3.22.1, Gradle wrapper 9.8.2; run :app:assembleDebug.
This reproduces the build process, not a promise of byte-identical signed APKs.
